text:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — Q4 roadmap delta: Ops wants to hold back the new Dedicated pricing SKU until enablement materials are ready. Need tradeoff call: speed to market vs. launch quality.
Marco (Growth): We should sequence a small PLG experiment behind a flag: keep conversion funnel but delay full public pricing change. :thinking_face:
Jules (Sales): Customers are already asking for committed discounts. If we delay public SKU, deal risk goes up for two mid-market pilots. Need comms plan for existing prospects.
Priya (Marketing): We can do a gated launch to existing signups + pilot accounts, promotes as "early access" — gives us 2 weeks to finish sales enablement. Will need product one-pager + playbook.
Sam (BizOps): Can we quantify risk? If we push 2 weeks, what's Delta to attainment for ARR? I can run scenario sims but need ask list from Sales & PD.
Ava (Product): High-level ask list: 1) enablement deck (Sellers) 2) pricing FAQ + objection handling 3) console screenshots & screenshot copy 4) short onboarding flow test with pilot customers.
Jules (Sales): I can draft the seller deck Qs and compile prospect objections by EOD. Will include suggested discount language.
Priya (Marketing): I can draft the public comms and the "early access" landing copy. Need final SKU name and 1-liner from Product.
Ava (Product): SKU name options: "Dedicated Reserve" or "Dedicated Plus" — leaning Reserve. 1-liner: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput and SLA-backed latency."
Marco (Growth): If we gate to pilots, we should instrument a tight funnel metric set: MQL->Activation, time-to-first-request, retention after 14 days. I'll add variant for caching defaults.
Sam (BizOps): Timeline proposals: Option A: ship gated pilot in 2 weeks with limited docs. Option B: full public launch in 6 weeks with enablement + PR. Which do we pick?
Ava (Product): Prefer Option A (2 weeks gated) if Sales can accept pilot-only commitments and Marketing can produce the core assets. We'll target pilot cohort of 10 customers.
Jules (Sales): Pilot cohort ok. I need legal to confirm pilot terms & discount cadence; I'll loop in legal.
Priya (Marketing): For pilot: deliverables = 1-pager, two email templates, landing page, seller cheat sheet. I'll aim for drafts in 4 business days.
Ava (Product): Launch criteria (must-haves):
```
- Seller deck + FAQ ready
- Legal sign-off on pilot T&Cs
- Pilot onboarding flow tested with >=3 customers
- Metrics dashboards wired (MQL->activation, latency, cost per token)
```
Marco (Growth): I'll wire the dashboards and add experiment tags.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: gated-pilot/dedicated-reserve -> canary -> 10 customers. ETA: 2027-11-05 14:00 UTC.
Sam (BizOps): I'll run ARR impact sims once Jules posts ask list.
Ava (Product): Action items: Jules = objections + legal loop, Priya = deliverables drafts, Marco = metrics + feature flag, Sam = ARR sims. Check-in Friday 10am PT.
Priya (Marketing): :thumbsup: adding to my calendar.
Jules (Sales): On it.
Marco (Growth): will tag feature flags.
Ava (Product): Thanks team — aim for gated pilot cadence, we can re-evaluate for public launch after pilot metrics.
